title: Halal Mod
description: Divine retribution for haram minecraft acts (munching on pork)
body:
# Halal Mod

A Minecraft mod that enforces halal dietary laws with divine retribution. If a player consumes pork products, they will die.

## Features

- Detects when players attempt to eat porkchop or cooked porkchop
- Waits for players to fully consume the forbidden food
- Strikes sinners with multiple lightning bolts
- Delivers divine punishment with a custom death message
- Accurately tracks food consumption with hunger level verification
- Provides exceptions for starving players (Hunger < 3)

## Dependencies

- Fabric API (included with most Fabric installations)

## How It Works

The mod keeps track of players who attempt to consume pork products. After the standard Minecraft eating animation completes (approximately 1.6 seconds), the mod checks if the player's hunger level increased, confirming they actually ate the pork. If so, divine retribution is delivered in the form of multiple lightning strikes and instant death, accompanied by a custom death message.
